ci_sndbuf_resolution.original_trace_limit: No original phase/queue snapshot; the1137 events are not retroactively claimed as kernel-traced.
ci_sndbuf_resolution.cause: The no-loss delay profile used an unbounded veth line with a finite10000-packet queue; the reproduced overflow mapped one-for-one to UDP SndbufErrors.
ci_sndbuf_resolution.correction: Define the CI no-loss control as100Mbit/s without loss/jitter; keep10000queue and strict zero positive-error gates. Verify overflow reporting with a warmed raw UDP probe in separate disposable namespaces.

functional_evidence_source.reason: same immutable binaries; completed smoke precedes unrelated later host allowance guard; no redundant rerun

mixed_quantile_semantics: Each latency cell is the median of six per-run quantiles, not a pooled quantile. Idle generators run5s and loaded generators10s. Results describe this path/CPU envelope, not universal fairness or priority.
real_counter_coverage: Fresh namespace through final idle and observer collection, including planned client replacements; final server teardown follows collection. CI separately asserts counters through endpoint shutdown.
connection_semantics: Each matrix invocation uses one finite1MiB warmup and a new HTTP benchmark transport. Each proxy invocation also starts a fresh client process/QUIC tunnel; only that mode runs. Server processes persist. Mixed cycles retain one client, with a second client only for explicit overload. Planned transitions and each retired client reconnect check are recorded. This is an end-to-end proxy comparison, not an isolated congestion-controller microbenchmark.
limits: BBR is experimental opt-in; default Reno and compression=false unchanged.
No universal speedup or fairness claim; payload, CPU, path and loss matter.
Memory peaks are execution-cgroup accounting, not total host memory; host MemAvailable is guarded and reported separately.
No physical mobile migration or multi-day stability proof.
timing: Goodput uses complete delivered bytes divided by full generation-plus-drain time; warmup reported separately.
